scientific_limitations: The exact coefficient is a one-variable supremum; no elementary closed form or proof of uniqueness of the numerical maximizer is claimed.
The decimal approximation is not a certified interval and is not used in the proof.
The result applies only to finite qubit ensembles and complementary Pauli projective measurements; no extension to nonorthogonal axes, arbitrary POVMs, or higher dimensions is claimed.
The full text of the 2014 CQC article was not accessible; its available abstract reports special-case CQC results.
A related 2026 state-dependent corrected CQC inequality is different from the one-sided coefficient optimized here; the claim remains restricted to the two-qubit setting for its corollary.
title: Sharp universal coefficient for qubit half-information exclusion
